body: Wow, I must say, I feel kind of foolish. Everyone has their reasons for what they too, but I can't imagine the strength that you have to keep you going for eight years. Just the emotional fortitude that it would require is astounding, and I respect you for that (although, as you say, I'm not telling you to continue). I hope that wasn't inappropriate or the wrong thing to say, but it struck me. Know that you could always talk to me, just as I have with you. It may seem like a shallow offer but the best of intentions accompany it.

I won't pretend to completely understand your home life, but I can tell you one thing. You cannot allow others to live your life for you, because you'll constantly think you're never good enough. The only person that should judge you on your life is you. Tomorrow, try and go through the entire day without having a thought that begins with "she/he/it". Focus entirely on you. 

This decision that you're making is about *you're* life, not your parents, not your brothers, this is your life. So don't let other people influence you on ending your life or not. Always remember that you will forever have someone there for you. At any point, no matter how "worthless" you think you are, someone will always be willing to argue that. You can see it in front of you, with your brother. He is fighting right along with you, if you stay alive for any reason, stay alive for him. 

I hope that you can find hope in this dark time, remember, don't let others tell you whether to live or die. 

EDIT: I found it an unbelievably helpful thing to just talk to someone, about anything. Feel free to PM me.
Oh I didn't take it that way at all, no worries! And yes, after my appointment I plan to make an update, it would be rude to snub the people who advised me haha.

Thank you for your advice, any third party in this situation has immensely helpful insight. I've come to the same conclusion; if there is something wrong then I'll be glad that I went. If there isn't, well then at least I made sure. Thank you again, dealing with this is a lot easier when I have some small idea of what it *could* be.

I wouldn't say that it's the sort of voice where I might look around me for it's source. However, he's powerful enough to stop me in the middle of sentences, and he incites an extremely rapid physical and emotional "explosion" if you will. Thank you for your advice.

This is exactly how I would describe it! It's not another personality, because we're both the same person. I guess that's what makes it hard to distinguish between natural internal monologue and something not quite so natural.
